steps: Independently review the exact manifest hash, finite origins and classifications; original receipts remain immutable.
Verify every candidate archive is a regular file and matches archive SHA/size; gzip-decompress and match original SHA/size. Recheck explicit origin pins or immutable Git blob bindings as needed.
Root alone creates the new destination directory. For each manifest record, copy only archive_candidate to archive_destination; refuse an existing unequal destination instead of overwriting history.
Copy this root-copy-guide.json and retention-allowlist.json after source-to-destination verification, retaining any independent review receipt separately.
Read back every destination archive and compare hashes/decompressed bytes to manifest. Do not import preparer scripts or unlisted temporary neighbors.
Root supplements full206/security2 completion and npm/gates in a separate finite record set after their review; do not mutate this frozen candidate.
no_execution: Imported payloads are inert .gz evidence. This guide does not execute scripts, Cargo, Docker, SQL or migrations.
remaining_holds: Independent review and exact root serial import/readback
Separate full206 runtime and npm/gate retention by root
Broader Account lifecycle and production/publication/legal authority
